The new Castle Rock VA Clinic is a fantastic addition to our community for the nearly 8,000 veterans who call Douglas County home.

From mental health services to nutrition assistance and lab services, this location is built to take care of the men and women who served our nation so heroically. 

Our ribbon-cutting ceremony was a great event, and the facility (3753 Dacoro Lane, Castle Rock) will be ready to see patients on Monday, May 19!

Today, the House of Representatives PASSED five of my amendments to the Veterans Affairs appropriations package. My amendments redirect funding from bureaucrats to fund: 

✅ Medical and prosthetic research
✅ Combating waste, fraud, and abuse
✅ Constructing new state-extended care facilities
✅ Grants to provide burial benefits for veterans in rural areas
✅ Reducing the backlog at the Board of Veteran Appeals so veterans' claims are expedited
